name: P.S.P. Specialties Public Company Limited
summary: P.S.P. Specialties Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells lubricant and grease oils in Thailand. It operates through Sales and Services segments. The company offers automotive and industrial lubricants, such as passenger car motor, motorcycle, heavy-duty diesel engine, marine engine, hydraulic, industrial engine and gear, turbine, heat transfer, compressor and refrigeration, white, and natural gas engine oil; transmission fluids; coolants; and metal working fluids.
